lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgCd3(SeO5)2 crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 148), with 42 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Cd in a tetrahedral environment of four O neighbors, Mg in an octahedral environment of six O neighbors, and Se in an octahedral environment of six O neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Cd tetrahedra and Mg octahedra, between Cd tetrahedra and Se octahedra, and between Mg and Se octahedra, forming a three-dimensional periodic connectivity network.
